description: Deterministic index of named declarations (C/C++, shell, Python, JavaScript) in this repository, so contributors search existing implementations before adding new code. Regenerate after every source change; the drift gate fails when the committed manifests do not match the code.
coverage_rules: Indexes C/C++ function definitions and declarations, shell functions, Python defs/classes, and JavaScript functions/classes.
Excludes third-party trees (`contrib/`, `src/e9patch/vendor/wamr/`), build output (`build/`, `.cosmocc/`), release artifacts, and hidden directories.
Writes a per-directory `FUNCTION_SUBMANIFEST.md` only where named declarations were found.
directory_notes: Search this submanifest before adding a function in this directory; reuse, extend or wrap an existing one first.
Prefer the Cosmopolitan Libc APIs shipped with the pinned cosmocc toolchain over new platform wrappers.
